title: How the lab works with industry
intro: Three engagement models. Every engagement is scoped before student work begins.

models.title: Year-long track engagements
models.body: A partner sits with one research track across the academic year. Faculty and graduate residents hold the brief; students train on the problem inside a scoped studio.

models.title: Sponsored sprints & day hacks
models.body: Short, time-boxed studios and public hacks—including events such as Hack iX—with visiting mentors in the room for the duration of the sprint.

models.title: Platform & infrastructure partnerships
models.body: Tools, engines, and platforms stay with the partner. The lab uses them as given infrastructure and does not re-author the stack.

note: The lab authors its creative and behavioral work openly; partner platforms remain the partner's. Every engagement is scoped before student work begins.
